facts: Enron states that it values respect, communication, excellence, and open markets.
The company describes itself as a laboratory of innovation that employs top talent.
Enron values diversity in people and thought to maintain an outstanding workforce.
The company commits to meeting customer energy needs through long-term partnerships.
Enron operates safely with concern for the environment across its global business locations.
The copyright notice spans the years 1997 to 2000.
